name: AI Controls Matrix
description: CSA AI Controls Matrix v1.1.0 — current AICM release. 247 controls across 18 domains, with cross-framework mappings to BSI AI C4, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. Companion to CCM for general-cloud-security controls; AICM adds AI-specific overlays. Ships as a ZIP bundle with the AICM spreadsheet, the standalone AI-CAIQ v1.1.0 questionnaire, and three PDF guidance documents.
relationToCloudSecurity: AICM controls layer on top of cloud-platform controls (covered by CCM). For AI workloads in cloud, both frameworks apply together.
relationToAISecurity: AICM is THE current cloud-industry AI controls catalog. Used in CSA STAR for AI Level 1 self-assessments.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Copyright notice in the v1.1.0 workbook reads © Copyright 2026 Cloud Security Alliance.

lifecycle.notes:
AI Controls Matrix v1.1 Released: 06/22/2026, per CSA's artifact page at https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/artifacts/ai-controls-matrix-v1-1. That is the date recorded in the `published` field above.

The source bundle carries four different dates for this release. The publisher's download page is treated as authoritative because it is the citable public statement of record; the others are build and packaging artifacts that describe stages of production rather than the release itself.

Dates considered and not used:
  - 2026-06-18 — the `generated_at` token in both spreadsheet filenames. This is when the workbooks were generated from CSA's internal tooling, four days before publication. Retained as `generated_at` in the extraction JSON for provenance, but it is not the release date.
  - 2026-06-22 — filesystem mtime on both spreadsheets inside the ZIP. Coincides with the artifact-page date, but mtimes are not a reliable published-on signal and are not cited independently.
  - 2026-06-23 — the date on the AICM v1.1.0 row of the workbook's own Change Log sheet, one day after the artifact page. Likely when the change log itself was finalized.
  - 2026-03-17 — the AI-CAIQ v1.1.0 row of the questionnaire's Change Log, three months earlier. This dates the questionnaire revision, not the bundle release.

Version string: the workbook stamps itself 1.1.0 in cell A1 of every sheet ({"specification_name":"AI Controls Matrix","specification_version":"1.1.0"}); CSA's artifact page brands it "v1.1". The directory uses the workbook's own 1.1.0, matching the three-part 1.0.3 convention.

notes:
CONTROL IDs WERE RENUMBERED IN THIS RELEASE. 54 of the 242 control IDs shared with v1.0.3 now designate a different control; only one ID (IAM-19) disappeared outright, so an ID set-difference does NOT detect the change. Never migrate a v1.0.3 reference to v1.1.0 by string match — use ../crosswalks/aicm-1.0.3-to-1.1.0-crosswalk.csv. Per-control detail — what each 1.1.0 control was in 1.0.3 and what changed — is in CHANGELOG.md, with a machine-readable copy in aicm-1.1.0-changelog.json whose `id_reuse` field marks every repointed identifier. Full analysis and standing policy in ../VERSIONING.md.

SCHEMA CHANGE vs the 1.0.3 extraction: the ownership key 'gen_ai_ops_processing_infrastructure' is now 'cloud_ai_processing_infrastructure', following the source column rename from 'Gen AI Ops/Processing Infrastructure' to 'Cloud/AI Processing Infrastructure (PI)'. The 1.1.0 JSON also adds a top-level 'definitions' object (Control Type, Control Ownership, Threat Category, Other Definitions) that the 1.0.3 extraction omitted, and a 'mapping_frameworks' list naming the frameworks actually present.

known_source_issues.summary: The Scope Applicability (Mappings) sheet dropped from 16 columns to 13. The NIST AI 600-1:2024 mapping block, populated for all 243 controls in v1.0.3, is absent — while the same workbook's Change Log claims mapping rows were added 'across all four external frameworks'. Only BSI AI C4, EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 are present. Accepted as-shipped: the extraction carries the three frameworks actually present. Consumers needing NIST AI 600-1 mappings must use the 1.0.3 extraction, remembering that its control IDs are not interchangeable with 1.1.0.

GRC-01 through GRC-08 record the Cloud/AI Processing Infrastructure owner as 'Cloud Service Provider (CSP)' where the other 239 controls use the full form 'Owned by the Cloud Service Provider (CSP)'. Same meaning, inconsistent phrasing in the source. Normalized to the full form in the extraction so the ownership vocabulary is a closed set of 10 values. All 8 substitutions are itemized by control ID in source_data_notes.normalizations_applied in aicm-1.1.0.json, and the substitution table lives in OWNERSHIP_NORMALIZATIONS in scripts/parse_aicm.py.

Five Typical Control Applicability and Ownership cells are empty in the publisher's workbook: DSP-21 (Cloud/AI Processing Infrastructure), DSP-23 and DSP-24 (Cloud/AI Processing Infrastructure and Orchestrated Services). THIS IS NOT A DATA CONVERSION ERROR — CSA's spreadsheet does not state an owner for these cells. They are emitted as null to preserve the distinction between 'the publisher did not state this' and 'the extraction lost it'. Itemized cell-by-cell in source_data_notes.gaps_in_source in aicm-1.1.0.json, recomputed on every parse run so the record cannot drift from the data.

DSP-08 is the only control with no BSI AI C4 control mapping. THIS IS NOT A DATA CONVERSION ERROR — the mapping cell is empty in CSA's workbook. The same gap existed in v1.0.3 (242 of 243 populated), so it is long-standing rather than introduced by this release. EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 mappings are complete for all 247 controls. Recorded in source_data_notes.gaps_in_source in aicm-1.1.0.json.

desired_end_state.notes: 247 controls with guidelines, mappings, and embedded AI-CAIQ questions. Reproducible via scripts/parse_aicm.py. The companion questionnaire is extracted separately to ../../aicm-caiq/1.1.0/ via scripts/parse_caiq.py.
